title: Salesforce Flow Definition
description: Schema for a Salesforce Flow definition record from the Tooling API.

Id.description: Salesforce record ID for the FlowDefinition.

ApiName.description: Developer API name used to identify the flow programmatically.

Label.description: Human-readable label displayed in the Salesforce UI.

Description.description: Optional description of the flow's purpose.

Status.description: Current status of the flow version.

ProcessType.description: The type of flow, determining how it is triggered and used.

TriggerType.description: What event triggers the flow (for record-triggered and scheduled flows).

ActiveVersionId.description: ID of the currently active Flow version.

LatestVersionId.description: ID of the most recently saved (draft or active) Flow version.

CreatedDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the flow was created.

LastModifiedDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last modification.
